title: Govt launches two modules to digitise PMGSY process
source: Government News | Latest news on eGovernance, Digital India, Smart Cities | ET Government : ETGovernment.com
summary: The modules are electronic measurement book (e-MB) and electronic billing (e-billing), replacing the paper-based measurement and billing system that had been in use for two decades.

title: Hubble & Gaia solve our galaxy's merger mystery

title: China bounces back from Long March rocket explosion with back-to-back launches (video)
summary: China's space program has returned to flight after an Aug. 10 Long March 7A rocket explosion, launching both a Long March 12 and a Long March 2C rocket on Sunday (Aug. 16).

title: Blue Origin adding second pad to Cape Canaveral launch complex amid rocket explosion repairs
summary: As Blue Origin continues to repair its New Glenn launch pad following the rocket's explosion in May, the company has announced plans to build a second pad at the same complex to support the bigger, more powerful New Glenn "9x4" variant.
